question: What restaurant can I find within 160 kilometers in the forward direction toward Blauvelt Homestead, New City, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.990094 40.748387)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.98694 41.17103)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.990094 40.748387)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.990094 40.748387)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
